body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2025-04-30 (Q4FY25 concall transcript): "I think on the polymer side, we can expect a little higher growth between 25% to 30%." Metric: Polymer segment revenue growth. Target: +25-30% (FY25 base ~INR 455 cr). Deadline: 2026-03-31. Specificity: range; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: missed. Evidence: FY26 polymer INR 507 cr vs FY25 ~455 cr = ~+11% (company Q4FY26 call 'crossed INR 500 crores'; Nov-25 call gave H1FY25 199 cr). Explanation given: falling resin prices: 'volume growth ~40% but value lower' (Apr-26, prompted)
